title: Bust of Nefertiti

sourceNotes: The exact image is copied unchanged from Julio’s supplied reference. title: Marble portrait of the emperor Caracalla
creator: Unknown Roman sculptor
description: Caracalla’s closely framed marble head appears against charcoal, with the carved expression and worn surface clearly visible.
credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Samuel D. Lee Fund, 1940, accession 40.11.1a. Public-domain Open Access image.
viewType: Near-frontal head portrait; visually near eye level
sourceNotes: Unaltered original-resolution Met image DP333080.jpg, downloaded using the image URL supplied by its public collection API. The current collection page dates this object to 212–217 CE and labels the image Public Domain; the API returns isPublicDomain=true. This head is a fragment of a statue, not an originally independent bust. Its modeled turn and asymmetry remain unchanged. The image has no pronounced looking-up or looking-down presentation; exact camera elevation is not documented. The support at the lower edge is retained.
